narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Negative two eigh, squared, keeps its sign. It is minus four eigh squared.
<bookmark mark='times'/>Squaring means negative two eigh times negative two eigh.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A negative times a negative is positive, so a square can never be negative.
